# Step 1: 스킬 생성

def transform(ctx):
    book = ctx.book("@@FILE_1@@")
    sheet = "상품번호별"
    keep_headers = [
        "서비스", "본부명", "청구계정번호", "상품번호", "상품번호(한전)",

        "최초개통일", "모델명", "단말일련번호", "사용량(Mbyte)", 
        "개통대리점코드", "개통대리점명", "기본료", "부가세", "청구금액", "비고"
    ]
    
    # BA열 (53열) 은 명시적으로 삭제 대상
    ba_col_idx = 53 
    
    def idx_to_col(c):
        s = ""
        while c > 0:
            c, r = divmod(c - 1, 26)
            s = chr(65 + r) + s
        return s
        
    keep_indices = set()
    for h in keep_headers:
        try:
            col_idx = book.find_header(sheet, h, header_row=1)
            if col_idx != ba_col_idx: # BA열은 유지 목록에서 제외
                keep_indices.add(col_idx)
        except Exception:
            raise ValueError(f"헤더 '{h}'를 찾을 수 없습니다.")
            
    last_col_idx = book.used_last_col(sheet)
    all_indices = set(range(1, last_col_idx + 1))
    delete_indices = sorted(list(all_indices - keep_indices), reverse=True)
    
    if not delete_indices:
        raise ValueError("삭제할 열이 없습니다.")
        
    for idx in delete_indices:
        col_letter = idx_to_col(idx)
        book.delete_cols(sheet, col_letter)

Sub B2BSkill()
    Dim prevCalc As Long
    On Error GoTo Cleanup
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    prevCalc = Application.Calculation
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual
    
    Dim wb As Workbook
    Set wb = Workbooks("@@FILE_1@@")
    
    Dim sheetNames As Variant
    sheetNames = Array("고압자계기", "고압모계기", "무선간선망")
    
    Dim i As Long
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim lastCol As Long
    Dim headerRng As Range
    
    For i = LBound(sheetNames) To UBound(sheetNames)
        Set ws = wb.Worksheets(sheetNames(i))
        lastCol = ws.Cells(1, ws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
        If lastCol < 1 Then lastCol = 1
        Set headerRng = ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 1), ws.Cells(1, lastCol))
        
        With headerRng.Interior
            .Pattern = xlSolid
            .PatternColorIndex = xlAutomatic
            .Color = RGB(192, 192, 192)
        End With
    Next i
    
Cleanup:
    Application.Calculation = prevCalc
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        Err.Raise Err.Number, Err.Source, Err.Description
    End If
End Sub
